stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent v3.0.0 beta introduces opt-in macOS Notification Center reminders for user-entered interview and employer follow-up deadlines. Enable under Settings > Уведомления (off by default). Job Agent checks the existing local employer response tracker only while the app is open. Date-only actions alert during daytime on the due day; exact-time tasks alert on/near deadline, and interviews can alert in the preceding hour. Old overdue tasks remain visible in Applications without generating stale popup spam. A durable local notification journal deduplicates same job/stage/date across refreshes and restarts and limits macOS notifications to three per local day. Native notifications are requested by static AppleScript via osascript argv, with untrusted titles sanitized; no shell interpolation, no AppleScript from vacancy text. Existing applications.csv and employer_responses.json are not mutated by notification delivery, and scoring, human-only final Submit, and no-CAPTCHA behavior are unchanged. No background service or Gmail access is added; real banner display depends on macOS notification permissions. Offline GitHub Actions regression suite: 88/88 passed, including four new tests for preferences, timing, dedup, daily cap and safe arguments.
